nextStoryContext: US-011 adds per-worker deadline + pane-death detection. WaitForFn now returns { timedOut: boolean } and requires timeoutMs arg. IsPaneAlive injectable added. ReviewWaitForFn in review.ts is decoupled from WaitForFn. Timeout/pane-died blocked outcomes continue the loop (recovery to next story). CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS env var configures the timeout in next.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: tmux wait-for has no native timeout option. The spawnSync timeout + result.signal check is the correct mechanism to bound the wait. list-panes -t paneId exit code approach for pane-death detection matches the pattern already used by isWorkerPaneAlive in US-009.
